# failures
$ healthcli import apple <tmp>/missing.zip
--- error ---
file not found: <tmp>/missing.zip
$ healthcli import apple <tmp>/export.xml
--- error ---
not a valid Apple Health export (XML error: XML syntax error on line 1: unexpected EOF)
$ healthcli import apple <tmp>/notes.txt
--- error ---
not an Apple Health export (no <HealthData> element found)
$ healthcli import apple
--- error ---
import apple needs the export file, e.g. healthcli import apple export.zip
$ healthcli import apple ../../testdata/small/export.xml ../../testdata/small/export.xml
--- error ---
import apple got too many arguments (2); run "healthcli import apple --help" for how to use it
